requirements.description: The system shall manage user account registration, login, logout, password change, and password recovery as one account-credential lifecycle with validation and state transitions.
The system shall support administrator login and logout and allow authenticated administrators to view user and artwork lists.
The system shall support user profile pages, uploaded-work views, browsing history, and follow relationships, together with avatar and username maintenance.
The system shall manage user artwork submission, editing, deletion, review-progress tracking, and the administrator approval/rejection workflow for uploaded artworks.
The system shall provide artwork browsing, keyword/tag search, sorting/filtering, and detail retrieval for visitors and users.
The system shall provide popular recommendation, personalized recommendation, and a user-controlled switch to disable personalized recommendation.

The system shall manage favorites and favorite categories, including adding, viewing, querying, canceling favorites, creating public or private categories, deleting, renaming, changing visibility, and viewing another user's visible favorites.

The system shall support user comments and replies, administrator viewing and deletion of comments and replies, and event-driven notification creation when comments, replies, or review-progress changes occur.
The system shall support reading unread notifications, marking notifications as read, and deleting notifications in the notification interface.
The system shall enforce secure web requests, authenticated operations, server-side anti-abuse protections, vulnerability checks for dependencies, and encryption/revalidation of sensitive user data.

components.name: Security & API Gateway
components.description: Manages request routing, TLS termination, anti-abuse filtering, rate limiting, and centralized authentication/authorization enforcement.

components.name: Authentication & Identity Service
components.description: Handles credential lifecycle, user/admin authentication sessions, password recovery, state transitions, and sensitive data encryption.

components.name: User Profile & Social Graph Service
components.description: Manages user profiles, avatars, user identity metadata, browsing histories, and follow relationships.

components.name: Artwork Lifecycle & Moderation Service
components.description: Handles artwork creation, editing, deletion, state machine transitions, and administrator review/approval workflows.

components.name: Artwork Catalog & Search Service
components.description: Provides indexing, keyword and tag searching, multi-criteria filtering, sorting, and artwork details retrieval.

components.name: Recommendation Engine Service
components.description: Generates popular and personalized artwork recommendations and honors user preferences to toggle personalized recommendations.

components.name: Favorites & Collections Service
components.description: Manages user favorites and custom categories, including visibility control (public/private) and query endpoints.

components.name: Comments & Discussion Service
components.description: Processes comments, threaded replies, moderation deletions, and emits domain events for interactions.

components.name: Notification Management Service
components.description: Consumes domain events to generate notifications, tracks read/unread states, and handles notification deletion.

components.name: Administrator Portal Service
components.description: Provides administrator views for users, artworks, moderation queues, and comment management.

connectors.description: Validates credentials, session tokens, and enforces auth policies.
Routes profile, follow, and history requests.
Routes artwork submissions, modifications, and moderation requests.
Routes search, filter, and detail view requests.
Routes favorites and folder management requests.
Routes notification management and status updates.
Routes administrative queries and review operations.
Synchronizes approved/updated/deleted artwork metadata to search indices.
Emits review progress change events for notification generation.
Emits comment and reply creation events for notification delivery.
Retrieves user history and personalization preferences.
Fetches candidate artworks and metadata for ranking algorithms.
Retrieves artwork lists and sends approval/rejection moderation decisions.
Retrieves user list data for administrator overview.
Inspects and deletes inappropriate comments and replies.
